id: \bI've always wanted to train next to Koga.
en: \bI've always wanted to train next to Koga.
it: \bHo sempre desiderato allenarmi al fianco di Koga.

id: How will I impress him now?
en: How will I impress him now?
it: Come farò a fare colpo su di lui adesso?

id: \bEven though I lost, I will continue to train under Koga.
en: \bEven though I lost, I will continue to train under Koga.
it: \bAnche se ho perso, continuerò ad allenarmi sotto la guida di Koga.

id: \rReady to lose?
en: \rReady to lose?
it: \rPronto a perdere?

id: Guess not.
en: Guess not.
it: A quanto pare no.

id: \bI have much to learn.
en: \bI have much to learn.
it: \bHo ancora molto da imparare.

id: \bKoga uses Poison type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Ground and Psychic types.
en: \bKoga uses Poison type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Ground and Psychic types.
it: \bKoga usa Pokémon di tipo Veleno. Sono deboli contro i tipi Terra e Psico.

id: \bThey are strong against Grass and Fairy. Poison, Fighting, Bug, Grass, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Grass and Fairy. Poison, Fighting, Bug, Grass, and Fairy moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Erba e Folletto. Anche le mosse di tipo Veleno, Lotta, Coleottero, Erba e Folletto non fanno molti danni.

id: \bI don't particurally like Poison types.
en: \bI don't particurally like Poison types.
it: \bNon mi piacciono granché i tipi Veleno.

id: Did you like it?
en: Did you like it?
it: Ti è piaciuto?

id: \bLook very closely for gaps in the invisible walls!
en: \bLook very closely for gaps in the invisible walls!
it: \bCerca con molta attenzione i varchi nei muri invisibili!

id: \bKoga: Welcome child, to the Fuchsia Gym.
en: \bKoga: Welcome child, to the Fuchsia Gym.
it: \bKoga: Benvenuto, giovane, alla Palestra di Fucsiapoli.

id: \bNot every battle is about brute strength. Patience, strategy, and skill are just as important.
en: \bNot every battle is about brute strength. Patience, strategy, and skill are just as important.
it: \bNon tutte le lotte si basano sulla forza bruta. Pazienza, strategia e abilità sono altrettanto importanti.

id: \bLet's begin.
en: \bLet's begin.
it: \bCominciamo.

id: \bKoga: You've earned the Soul Badge.
en: \bKoga: You've earned the Soul Badge.
it: \bKoga: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Anima.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM06 contains Toxic. It is a status move that does more damage for every turn the Pokémon is in battle.
en: \bTM06 contains Toxic. It is a status move that does more damage for every turn the Pokémon is in battle.
it: \bL'MT06 contiene Tossina. È una mossa di stato che infligge più danni per ogni turno che il Pokémon passa in lotta.

id: \bKoga: Continue to practice and hone your skills.
en: \bKoga: Continue to practice and hone your skills.
it: \bKoga: Continua ad allenarti e ad affinare le tue abilità.

id: \bLight and shadow. Which is better?
en: \bLight and shadow. Which is better?
it: \bLuce e ombra. Cos'è meglio?

id: Good answer.
en: Good answer.
it: Buona risposta.

id: \bLight or shadow? Which do you pick?
en: \bLight or shadow? Which do you pick?
it: \bLuce o ombra? Cosa scegli?

id: \bKoga is a master of disguise.
en: \bKoga is a master of disguise.
it: \bKoga è un maestro del travestimento.

id: Not good enough.
en: Not good enough.
it: Non abbastanza.

id: \bThere are hidden walls in the Gym.
en: \bThere are hidden walls in the Gym.
it: \bIn Palestra ci sono dei muri nascosti.

id: \bKoga is good, but not as good as me.
en: \bKoga is good, but not as good as me.
it: \bKoga è bravo, ma non quanto me.

id: You'll pay for this.
en: You'll pay for this.
it: Me la pagherai.

id: \bI like poison and sleep techniques, they linger after battle!
en: \bI like poison and sleep techniques, they linger after battle!
it: \bAdoro le tecniche di veleno e sonno, durano anche dopo la lotta!
